description: This file defines a public enumeration ShareToAgentSettings that manages shared user defaults for storing and retrieving a default instruction string, with support for fallback values.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves the default instruction string from shared user defaults, trims whitespace, and returns a fallback if not set or empty.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Saves a provided instruction string to shared user defaults after trimming whitespace; removes the key if the string is empty or nil.
